meta_description: IEC 62443 zones across pipeline OT — the security audit passed with zero findings and remote maintenance access brought under controlled gateways

blocks.x: IEC 62443 zones across pipeline OT, the security audit passed with zero findings and remote maintenance access brought under controlled gateways

Identity withheld, a gas TSO whose compressor stations ran trusted-by-proximity OT and whose remote maintenance vendors connected like they owned the place. Figures are the client's own, shared with permission.

The baseline assessment mapped the proximity trust: 87 remote-maintenance pathways reaching OT directly, zone-and-conduit concepts on paper since the last audit, and jump hosts shared across vendors with credentials nobody rotated.
The constraint was throughput, compressor stations could not stop, and the vendor estate could not be frozen. Security had to move at the speed of maintenance windows.

We zoned the OT estate at maintenance speed: conduits per vendor with gateway-enforced session control, jump-host consolidation with per-vendor identity and recorded sessions, remote access windows agreed with each vendor's own crew, and the audit evidence generated by the gateways themselves. Proximity trust retired vendor by vendor, with crews holding the schedule.
